scope: Primary papers, official standards and original technical documentation relevant to structured task observations, measurement provenance, data minimization and privacy. Targeted research, not an exhaustive systematic review.

sources.title: Semantic conventions for generative client AI spans
sources.status: Development; mutable main branch; adapter implementation must pin a revision
supports: content capture sensitivity and default omission
sources.application: Map selected counters and error enums through a deny-by-default adapter, never forward raw telemetry attributes.
sources.limitations: Telemetry semantics do not establish task difficulty, independent evidence, or anonymization.
sources.notes: The old official website page reports that GenAI conventions moved to this official repository.

sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
sources.application: Keep detailed provenance locally and transmit only fixed source classes and transformation versions.
sources.limitations: A provenance graph does not prove that the source statements are true; raw URIs and entity links can identify private work.

sources.title: De-Identifying Government Datasets: Techniques and Governance
sources.application: Separate private raw numeric observations from approved public aggregates and assess combinations of dimensions.
sources.limitations: This is technical guidance; following a few transformations is not proof of universal anonymity or a legal compliance opinion.

sources.title: NIST Privacy Framework: A Tool for Improving Privacy through Enterprise Risk Management, Version 1.0
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.application: Bind each field to a necessary analysis and allow separate opt-in by observation group.
sources.limitations: Explicitly refers to version 1.0 principles, not a claim that version 1.0 is the newest publication.

sources.title: The Algorithmic Foundations of Differential Privacy
sources.application: Future public query mechanisms need defined adjacency, contribution bounds, an accountant and release policy.
sources.limitations: OpenCost has not obtained differential privacy guarantees by hashing, threshold suppression or this research review.

sources.title: Datasheets for Datasets
supports: dataset motivation composition collection intended use documentation
sources.application: Version metadata for collection scope, selection, missingness and permitted uses.
sources.limitations: The cited year is the original preprint year; documentation does not itself remove bias or validate scores.

sources.title: Data Cards: Purposeful and Transparent Dataset Documentation for Responsible AI
supports: dataset lifecycle and upstream source transparency
sources.application: Provide a user-readable measurement card alongside each feedback snapshot.
sources.limitations: A well-documented card does not establish representativeness or true task outcomes.

sources.title: Model Cards for Model Reporting
sources.application: Attach task context, sample coverage and recommendation scope to model plus Harness comparisons.
sources.limitations: The cited year is the original preprint year; do not import demographic collection suggestions into OpenCost task telemetry.

sources.title: Measurement and Fairness
sources.application: Keep intrinsic requirement observations separate from outcome, latency, tokens and subjective difficulty labels.
sources.limitations: The paper motivates measurement validation; it provides no ready-made universal AI task difficulty coefficient.
sources.notes: Original preprint 2019-12-11; checked version v3 dated 2021-03-12.

sources.title: NASA Task Load Index (TLX): Paper and Pencil Package - Volume 1.0
sources.application: Optional human-reported experience only; never infer TLX ratings from conversations or use them as intrinsic task difficulty.
sources.limitations: Deleting dimensions or replacing participants with an LLM creates a different instrument and requires validation.

sources.title: The SPACE of Developer Productivity: There's more to it than you think
supports: activity alone does not capture productivity
sources.application: Report outcome, quality, time and workflow diagnostics separately rather than one activity-derived user ability score.
sources.limitations: Software developer research does not establish weights for all AI-assisted work domains.

sources.title: Robust De-anonymization of Large Sparse Datasets
supports: high-dimensional sparse records can be linked using auxiliary information
sources.application: Avoid releasing per-task high-dimensional vectors, detailed timelines or stable source-derived identifiers.
sources.limitations: The attack study is not a quantitative risk estimate for the present OpenCost database.
